structured.response_summary: Rename the branch you are currently on with `git branch -m new-name`, or rename another local branch with `git branch -m old-name new-name`. Verify with `git branch --show-current` or `git branch --list`. This changes only the local branch; if it was already published, push the renamed branch with `git push -u origin new-name`, then delete the old remote branch only after confirming the new one exists: `git push origin --delete old-name`.
